title: Muon Attains $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-3})$ Iteration Complexity under Shuffling
abstract: arXiv:2611.18124v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Muon is a stochastic first-order optimizer for matrix-valued parameters. It maintains an exponential moving average of stochastic gradients in a momentum buffer with coefficient $\beta$, and orthogonalizes the buffer to obtain the update direction. Muon has been reported to accelerate and stabilize the training of large language models. In practice, it is often used with shuffling (sampling without replacement), where each epoch visits the components of a finite-sum objective in a permuted order. However, its iteration complexity in this setting remains open. We analyze Muon under shuffling, with the momentum buffer orthogonalized by the polar map. For smooth nonconvex finite-sum problems, we establish an $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-3})$ iteration complexity for finding an $\varepsilon$-stationary point. translated_title: Muon在随机重排下达到 $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-3})$ 迭代复杂度
translated_abstract: Muon 是一种针对矩阵值参数的随机一阶优化器。它以系数 $\beta$ 在动量缓冲区中维护随机梯度的指数滑动平均，并对该缓冲区进行正交化以获得更新方向。据报道，Muon 能够加速并稳定大型语言模型的训练。在实践中，它通常与随机重排一起使用，即每个 epoch 以置换的顺序遍历有限和目标的各个分量。然而，其在该设置下的迭代复杂度仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们在随机重排设置下分析了 Muon，其中动量缓冲区通过极映射进行正交化。对于光滑非凸有限和问题，我们建立了寻找 $\varepsilon$-驻点的 $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-3})$ 迭代复杂度。该保证对任意置换序列均成立，涵盖了随机重排、单次重排和增量梯度方法。
tldr: 本文首次在随机重排采样下对Muon优化器进行了收敛性分析，证明了对于光滑非凸有限和问题寻找ε-驻点具有O(ε⁻³)的迭代复杂度，且该保证对任意置换序列均成立。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes an O(ε⁻³) iteration complexity for the Muon optimizer under shuffling for finding ε-stationary points of smooth nonconvex finite-sum problems, with the guarantee holding for arbitrary permutation sequences.
